keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Telstar 1, Utrecht 0. Tyrone Owusu (Telstar) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner following a fast break.
Goal! Telstar 2, Utrecht 0. Abdelnour Soualhia (Telstar) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ar'Jany Martha with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Utrecht. Per Kloosterboer replaces Arthur Zagré.
Substitution, Utrecht. Ángel Alarcón replaces Siebe Horemans.
Goal! Telstar 2, Utrecht 1. Ángel Alarcón (Utrecht) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Marius Broholm with a cross.
Goal! Telstar 3, Utrecht 1. Nökkvi Thórisson (Telstar) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Tyrone Owusu with a through ball.
First Half ends, Telstar 3, Utrecht 1.
Substitution, Utrecht. Artem Stepanov replaces Oualid Agougil.
Second Half begins Telstar 3, Utrecht 1.
Goal! Telstar 3, Utrecht 2. Yoann Cathline (Utrecht) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Joris van Overeem.
Goal! Telstar 4, Utrecht 2. Ar'Jany Martha (Telstar) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Nökkvi Thórisson following a fast break.
Substitution, Telstar. Rojendro Oudsten replaces Gabi Caschili.
Substitution, Telstar. Jeff Hardeveld replaces Marvin Peersman.
Substitution, Telstar. Noach Shenkman replaces Emirhan Demircan.
Dani de Wit (Utrecht) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Per Kloosterboer (Utrecht) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Utrecht. Adrian Blake replaces Marius Broholm.
Substitution, Telstar. Fofin Turay replaces Ar'Jany Martha.
Substitution, Telstar. Fabiano Rust replaces Nökkvi Thórisson.
Substitution, Utrecht. Sem van Duijn replaces Nikolas Panagiotou.
Second Half ends, Telstar 4, Utrecht 2.
